title: Filing: Nscale says it needs more funding for its 2027 commitments after ordering Nvidia chips for a $45B Anthropic deal, casting doubt on its planned $35B IPO (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Filing: Nscale says it needs more funding for its 2027 commitments after ordering Nvidia chips for a $45B Anthropic deal, casting doubt on its planned $35B IPO — Nvidia-backed ‘neocloud’ tells investors it must obtain additional financing to fulfil Anthropic contracts
